name: The Retirement Game
description: Compress 43 years of retirement decisions into five decade rounds. Riley Carter starts at 22 with a $40k salary and a 401(k) packet on the desk. Capture the match, pick the cheap fund, ride the compound chart against three peer benchmarks, and see what your 22-year-old self really chose at 65.
